$comment: Audit state for the Prompt-1 methodology run, 2026-08-08. The previous schema-documentation pass's state is preserved as AUDIT/state.schema-pass.json.

priorPasses.note: All prior claims predate the 3b04c00 restructure and were re-verified in this pass rather than inherited.

baseline.lint: PASS (now covers BOTH workspaces; previously API was silently skipped)

findings.title: Prior audit evidence base deleted from the repository
findings.impact: Record of what was found, accepted and left open was destroyed; a reader at HEAD would conclude no audit ever ran. Code fixes survive.

findings.title: English locale labelled Toman amounts as IRR, understating every price 10x
findings.impact: English-locale users saw prices 10x low. Withdrawal form labelled a Toman input 'Amount (IRR)'.
findings.regression_test: money.spec.ts 'labels the amount as Toman in both locales, never IRR (FIN-101)'

findings.title: Refund could exceed the captured amount under concurrency
findings.impact: Over-refund landed as withdrawable wallet credit. A double-click on the admin refund button was sufficient.
findings.regression_test: refunds.service.spec.ts Serializable isolation test - verified to FAIL pre-fix

findings.title: Reconciliation.providerAmount records our own gatewayAmount, not the provider's
findings.impact: Defeats the independent cross-check the table exists for; a genuine amount mismatch would be invisible.

findings.title: 7 high dependency advisories, 5 reachable in production
findings.location: npm audit: next, sharp, nanoid, @nestjs/swagger, js-yaml
findings.impact: Next.js alone carries 8 advisories. Prior audit's '2 high, web only' claim is stale - @nestjs/swagger->js-yaml is in the API tree.
findings.note: Needs a Next.js major bump; ground rule 3 puts unrequested dependency upgrades out of scope.

findings.title: Upload MIME type is client-declared, never content-sniffed
findings.impact: Bounded: storage is a separate origin and the key is never user-controlled, but arbitrary content can be stored under a chosen content type.

findings.title: JWT verification had no algorithm allowlist
findings.impact: Not exploitable as configured (symmetric key); pinned so a future asymmetric key cannot reintroduce algorithm confusion.

findings.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML for the Enamad trust seal
findings.impact: Value is a build-time operator-controlled env var, not user input. Accepted.

findings.title: /bookings state-changing routes had no rate limit
findings.impact: Unthrottled caller could squat every slot a teacher has and force serialization conflicts against legitimate bookers.

findings.title: POST /auth/logout was public, DB-writing and unthrottled
findings.note: Found by authorization.spec.ts on its first run; the route had been reviewed by eye twice and read as fine.

findings.title: API had no ESLint config or lint script; 191 files never linted
findings.impact: Every historical 'lint green' claim, including the prior audit's, covered only the web app.

findings.title: queue and bookings deep-imported commerce internals
findings.impact: Both files had already been moved once by 3b04c00, breaking the coupling and being patched rather than bounded.
findings.regression_test: architecture.spec.ts - verified to FAIL pre-fix, naming the exact edge

findings.title: ESLint no-restricted-imports glob silently passed
findings.impact: A lint rule that reports nothing is worse than no rule - a green run reads as proof. Enforcement moved to a test.

findings.title: Two parallel overlapping token systems with near-but-unequal values
findings.impact: Same visual concept renders at two slightly different values; root cause of DES-505.

findings.title: 163 raw hex literals bypass the tokens
No spacing, type or leading scale exists
--muted body text failed WCAG AA at 4.19:1
findings.impact: Of two duplicate secondary-text tokens, the more widely used one failed accessibility.
findings.note: Measured with WCAG 2.1 relative luminance. An earlier draft named the wrong token and estimated the wrong number; correction recorded in 05-design.md.

verified: Baseline gates re-measured at ebdb499: typecheck/lint/test/build green, 193 tests
No Float or Decimal on any money column; all money is Int
Toman->Rial conversion symmetric across gateway request() and verify()
Verify-before-grant: entitlement granted only on gateway.verify() ok
Amount re-derived server-side from booking.price/pkg.price; no price ever accepted from a request body
Wallet is an append-only ledger with derived balance; no mutable balance column
Commission split sums back exactly (net derived by subtraction)
Double-booking guarded by Redis lock + Postgres Serializable (SSI)
No IDOR across the 42 authenticated-unscoped routes; all self-scoped at the service layer
No mass assignment, no injection, no committed secrets in any commit
Module boundaries: 0 circular deps; 6 cross-module edges, all through public surfaces
LIVE: 22 flows against a running stack (postgres/redis/minio + API), 22 PASS
LIVE: verify-before-grant proven by forging a callback with Status=OK against an unpaid Zarinpal sandbox authority -> payment FAILED, booking stayed PENDING_PAYMENT
LIVE: 3 concurrent gateway redirects -> one authority, two PAYMENT_GATEWAY_BUSY (FIN-002 holds under real parallelism)
LIVE: IDOR blocked with 404 (not 403) when student B targeted student A's booking
LIVE: replayed idempotencyKey returned the same payment row
LIVE: rate limiting blocked the auditor mid-walkthrough; RateLimit-* and Retry-After headers correct (RATE-007)
notVerified: Successful paid path end to end - needs a human at the Zarinpal sandbox checkout page
Refund and payout flows live - depend on a PAID payment
Browser/UI verification in either locale; no screenshot matrix; Playwright specs not executed
Component loading/empty/error state coverage across all 40+ components
Reconciliation sweep against a live gateway - needs a real ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID (inherited gap)

inheritedOpen.note: GET /teachers throughput plateau; a dev-mode capacity measurement, not a code defect.
fixed-window ~2x boundary burst, accepted at current limits

approvedChanges.what: Migrate canonical money storage from Toman to Rial
approvedChanges.approvedBy: user 2026-08-08, against the audit's recommendation to keep Toman
approvedChanges.scope: 28 money columns of 70 Int columns. Discount.value/DiscountRule.value are conditional on type<>'percent'; CreditEntry.amount is a lesson-credit count and all counts/percentages/durations are excluded.
stepsDone: 1. centralise the formatter on the current unit (Toman) - closed FIN-101 independently
stepsPending: 3. data migration (irreversible; needs a verified backup)
4. flip the formatter to divide by 10
approvedChanges.auditNote: This migration fixes no defect that currently exists. The Toman design is internally consistent and the only real bug (FIN-101) was a display label, already closed by step 1.

next_action: Priority 1 backlog: Next.js major bump (SEC-201); human-driven live verification of the successful paid path; monitoring for stuck payments. See docs/fa/07-کارهای-باقی‌مانده.md.
